notes: Version 2.55 records Gravity 3.9 and SG-Note 2.5. Gravity normalises its Born–Infeld completion by the prefactor 1/(8πG_N ℓ_sp^2), chosen so that the linear term reproduces the supplied Einstein term with coefficient 1/(16πG_N); this is a normalisation, not a derivation of G_N. The admissibility conditions (C1)–(C5) are hypotheses of Gravity: (C1) expresses covariance and implies (C4), (C2) normalises the linear term, and (C3) and (C5) are assumptions; none is supplied by BornInfeld, whose capacity axiom bounds a discrete per-node rate and no continuum curvature, nor by Foundation or ENI. SG-Note attributes ℓ_sp to Gravity's cutoff and the completion conditions to Gravity alone. The Gravity graph node description is updated; no paper status or edge changes.
